subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Autumn leaves __shuffled beneath him__ as he wandered through the quiet forest.
solution:
The correct answer is: **rustled underfoot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shuffled"** means to move with a dragging or scraping motion, often producing a soft sound. (घिसटना)

 
 
• **Example: **He shuffled his feet nervously while waiting for his turn to speak.
 
 
 
• **"Rustled"** refers to producing a soft, muffled sound, typically caused by the movement of dry leaves or paper. (सरसराना)
 
 
• **Example: **The wind rustled through the leaves, creating a soothing sound.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "rustled underfoot" is the most appropriate substitute for "shuffled beneath him," as it accurately describes the gentle sound made when walking on dry autumn leaves.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **rustled underfoot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crushed around** (चारों ओर कुचला): This implies something being pressed or flattened, which does not convey the sound of dry leaves being walked upon.

 
 
• **Example: **The crowd crushed around the stage to get a closer look at the performer.
 
 
 
• **Moved to another place** (दूसरी जगह स्थानांतरित): This refers to changing the position or location of something, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example: **The furniture was moved to another place to make room for the new carpet.
 
 
 
• **Died over** (मर गया): This phrase does not have any relevance in the context of the sentence, as it implies the end of life or cessation of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He died over a long illness that lasted several years.
